topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: The rain's been falling hard these last few days, painting the old neighborhoods in shades of grey. I got a call from two siblings who just inherited their grandma’s place down on Elm. They sound shaken, not sure what to do. In my experience, family inheritance can stir up more trouble than it’s worth. People start acting funny, making deals they shouldn't, whispering in corners. I’ve seen it a million times. They say there are things missing, things that shouldn't be. A will that’s suddenly gone missing, a safe that’s empty. The rain keeps drumming on the roof while I try to piece together what this could mean. Meetings in the dark, stories that don’t add up. I told them I’d swing by, take a look. Better to get a handle on this now, before it turns into something uglier.
